name: Marcela Lizbeth
bio:
Marcela Lizbeth (born April 4, 1997) is a Mexican actress.  Marcela studied a bachelor’s degree in Anthropology, while she was training acting. After graduating she began to train Anthropological Performance at the same time as starting her career in film professionally.

In 2023 she was nominated for Best Supporting Actress at the Queer International Film Festival in Playa del Carmen with the film "Cuando Cae La Tarde" (2023).

She has also collaborated on feature films and short films that have been presented at different film festivals around the world, to mention: "Elevación" (2024), official selection at the 77th Cannes Film Festival and 45th Habana Film Festival.

credits.title: ¿Dónde está la casa de mi padre?
Mi chica púrpura
credits.overview: A shy young man, used to seeing life in square shapes, dares to approach the new girl at school who makes him experience round sensations.

credits.title: When Afternoon Falls
credits.overview: Maca is a 16-year-old girl, who is reserved and inexperienced in love. She and Ana meet with the excuse of returning a sweater that Ana had previously lent her. In a daily afternoon they will experience the vulnerability of what it means to fall in love for the first time.

credits.title: Summer Of '99
credits.overview: In 1999, a Mexican family comes together to watch the thrilling final match between Toluca and Atlas, where the stakes are high and emotions run deep, uniting them in their shared passion for the game.

credits.title: Supernova
credits.overview: Andrea, a young woman in her early twenties, attends the party of her best friend Alan, where she has an unexpected encounter with Diego, a guy she used to have a relationship with. This plunges her into a whirlwind of feelings and memories.

credits.title: Elevation
credits.overview: Fugazi, a depressed girl, and Samuel, a boy looking for his missing brother, spend their days watching their city being taken by the army. Meanwhile, an uprising is growing on the streets…

credits.title: He, Behind the Gun
credits.overview: An ex-graffer, now security guard warns his brother about the dangers of joining riots against police brutality.  Although each brother walks a different path, at the end of the night, their journeys will cross.
